{{URL|https://ustc.edu}} | module = {{infobox Chinese | child = yes | title = University of Science and Technology of China | s = 中国科学技术大学 | t = 中國科學技術大學 | showflag = stp | p = Zhōngguó Kēxué Jìshù Dàxué | w = Chungkuo K'ehsüeh Chishu Tahsüeh | j = Zung1 gwok3 fo1 hok6 gei6 seot6 daai6 hok6 | altname = Zhongkeda | s2 = 中科大 | t2 = 中科大 | p2 = Zhōngkēdà | collapse = no | order = st }} }} [[File:Gate of USTC.JPG|thumb|Old North gate of the East Campus]] The '''University of Science and Technology of China''' ('''USTC''') is a [[public university]] in [[Hefei]], [[Anhui]], China. It is owned by the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]], and co-funded by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, the [[Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China|Ministry of Education of China]], and the [[Anhui Provincial People's Government|Anhui Provincial Government]]. It is part of [[Project 211]], [[Project 985]], and the [[Double First-Class Construction]]. The university was founded in [[Beijing]] by the Chinese Academy of Sciences in September 1958.{{Cite web |title=A Comprehensive Introduction to USTC::Introduction |url=https://www.its.caltech.edu/~ustcalum/intro/book/intro.html |access-date=2025-10-05 |website=www.its.caltech.edu}} In the beginning of 1970, the university moved to Hefei during the [[Cultural Revolution]].{{cite web |title=ABOUT at the University of Science and Technology of China |url=http://en.ustc.edu.cn/enabout/201101/t20110113_87799.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110528023706/http://en.ustc.edu.cn/enabout/201101/t20110113_87799.html |archive-date=2011-05-28}} The university has 13 schools, 11 national research platforms, 8 science-education integration colleges, and 5 joint cooperative institutes with local governments.{{Cite web |title=院系介绍-中国科学技术大学 |url=https://www.ustc.edu.cn/yxjs.htm |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20221125233101/https://www.ustc.edu.cn/yxjs.htm |archive-date=2022-11-25 |access-date=2022-11-25 |website=University of Science and Technology of China}} The university is a member of the [[C9 League]]. ==History== The university was founded in Beijing by the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) in September 1958. The director of CAS, [[Guo Moruo]] was appointed the first president of USTC. USTC's founding mission was to develop a high-level science and technology workforce, as deemed critical for the development of China's economy, defense, and science and technology education. The establishment was hailed as "A Major Event in the History of Chinese Education and Science." CAS has supported USTC by combining most of its institutes with the departments of the university. In 1959, USTC was listed in the top 16 [[National Key Universities|national key universities]], becoming the youngest national key university.{{Cite web |url=http://www.ustc.edu.cn/en/article/33/42ff23ec/ |title=University of Science and Technology of China(USTC) |access-date=2007-07-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070706212751/http://www.ustc.edu.cn/en/article/33/42ff23ec/ |archive-date=2007-07-06 |url-status=dead }} At the beginning of 1970, the university moved to Hefei during the Cultural Revolution. In 2012, USTC and the [[National University of Defense Technology]] signed a strategic agreement to cooperate on [[quantum computing]] research at a ceremony attended by [[Pan Jianwei]] and [[Yang Xuejun]].{{cite web |last1=CORBETT |first1=THOMAS |last2=SINGER |first2=PETER W. |title=Chinese Breakthroughs Bring Quantum Tools Closer to Practicality extract:
The University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) is a public university in Hefei, Anhui, China. It is owned by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and co-funded by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, the Ministry of Education of China, and the Anhui Provincial Government. It is part of Project 211, Project 985, and the Double First-Class Construction.
The university was founded in Beijing by the Chinese Academy of Sciences in September 1958. In the beginning of 1970, the university moved to Hefei during the Cultural Revolution. The university has 13 schools, 11 national research platforms, 8 science-education integration colleges, and 5 joint cooperative institutes with local governments. The university is a member of the C9 League.
